hero.headline: A method for becoming yourself.
hero.body: El Portal is built around a single conviction: identity isn't discovered, it's chosen, designed, rehearsed. The system gives you the structure. You bring the will.

principles.title: Identity comes first.
principles.body: You choose who you want to become. The system organizes the rest around that, including the skills your future identity needs, the habits that identity does without thinking, and the work that compounds toward it.

principles.title: The horizon has three scales.
principles.body: A Version is 90 days. A Cycle is 15. A Day is one. Strip any of them away and planning collapses into either daydreaming or grind.

principles.title: Track what your memory can't hold.
principles.body: You can't optimize what you can't see, and you can't see what you didn't capture. Log honestly. The patterns that matter aren't the ones you notice in the moment.

principles.title: The system reads. You decide.
principles.body: El Portal weighs the signals, including correlations, recurrences, and ripples. It surfaces what's working. The verdict is yours. A companion, not a coach.

principles.title: Friction is signal, not failure.
principles.body: When the same obstacle keeps showing up across cycles, that's data. The system flags recurrences so you address them at the root, rather than three months from now.

principles.title: Boring beats clever.
principles.body: Discipline compounds. The system protects the boring parts of the practice so the interesting work has somewhere to land.

principles.title: The right tool disappears.
principles.body: Check it at boot. Check it at shutdown. Invisible in between, while you do the work it supports.
